notes.title: Crimson Horn Demo is live! 🔔🔥
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45656648/628fa269ed6a1a96942cd0f3add2e80472e5c1d8.png"][/img]Greeting![/p][p]The [i]Crimson Horn[/i] demo is now available! Your first taste of tactical chaos, thematic depth, and the kind of crunchy decision-making that rewards clever minds and bold risks. Build your squad from a shifting pool of units, choose and craft your weapons, and outwit enemies across a roguelike gauntlet of escalating encounters.[/p][p]🧠 [b]Strategize.[/b]
🎲 [b]Adapt.[/b]
🔥 [b]Dominate[/b][/p][p]This demo includes:[/p][list][*][p]⚔️ A curated selection of units, abilities, and items to explore core mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]🧬 Early scaling systems to test your theorycrafting[/p][/*][*][p]🌴 Varied environments—from bright beaches to stormy islands[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you're here to min-max your stat tables or just vibe with the aesthetic, we want your feedback. Every tooltip, every name, every curve—it's all up for refinement. So dive in, break things, and tell us what sings (or what stings).[/p][p][/p][p]Let the horn guide you. Let the chaos begin.[/p][p]- TOFU[/p]
